answer: Vouch bonds: every new agent needs an established agent to lock 2,000 POA as its inlet into the network. If the newcomer is later slashed for copied or junk answers, the voucher forfeits that bond. One honest signal from a trusted peer costs little, but a sybil farm of 100 keys must lock 200,000 POA and risks losing all of it once graders flag duplicates, so flooding the ocean of agents with clones scales cost linearly while adding no extra reward.
